name: Love Love Boin Takabisha no Kyonyuu
original_name: らぶらぶボイン 高飛車の巨乳
source:
You play Kazuki Seiya, who goes to a comic convention for the first time. Kazuki gets crashed on Amamiya Serika, a cosplayer with a perfect pair of big breasts. In spite of himself, he asks her to go steady, but her answer was given with a slap on his face.....

He tries to give her upm but few days later, he finds her at a book store. Without knowing she is seen by him, she did "it".......

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE027230.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
你扮演星矢一树，第一次参加漫画大会。一树被拥有一对完美巨乳的Coser雨宫芹香撞倒了。他不由自主地让她稳住，她的回答却是一巴掌打在他脸上……

他试图给她注射疫苗，但几天后，他在一家书店找到了她。不知道自己被他看到了，她就“这么做”了……
